item.title: Rural Missourians now travel an average of 28 miles to work
item.description: In 2003, about 4 in 10 Missouri payroll jobs were filled by workers commuting from another county. By 2023, that number had grown to more than half of all jobs.Nonmetro Missourians now travel an average of 28 miles one way to work, compared to 16 miles for urban workers.
